title: The Neutral state on the border
subtitle: 战争和平 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）
meta: 主题语境：战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）　|　核心词汇：neutral　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 neutral 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the athlete wrote of ① a neutral state on the border in the programme, and everybody in the stadium said at once that it was ② so neutral that nobody in the stadium would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the athlete, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the neutral ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the neutral state on the border that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme for September 1977 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too neutral to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the trainer who had come to help; the neutral ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a neutral colour of the walls, and said that no trainer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as neutral as the colour of the walls they had once had in the old stadium. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was neutral or not, and he said so.

By 1990 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something neutral, and nothing besides. The trainer from the next stadium called the whole plan ⑧ quite neutral; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the neutral ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1993, in the rain, she wrote of another neutral state on the border in the same programme, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less neutral than anybody had expected. ⑩ The neutral colour of the walls that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1995, was the one she could never quite name; the neutral ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 中立（前置定语 a neutral state on the border：1983 年运动员在秩序册里记下的那件中立的国）
B. adj. 中立／中性（两处加强说法：so neutral that … 与 no less neutral than …）
C. adj. 中立／中性（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 中立（表语 too neutral to do：母亲觉得它太中立，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 中性（前置定语 a neutral colour of the walls：叔叔把整件事称作一桩中性的色）
F. adj. 中性（同级比较 as neutral as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩墙壁的中性色相比）
G. adj. 中性（后置定语 something neutral：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 中性（受程度副词修饰 quite neutral：那位陪练的评价）

items.q: a neutral state on the border
the neutral state on the border that
a neutral colour of the walls
The neutral colour of the walls that

answers.why: neutral 意为“中立”，1983 年运动员在秩序册里记下的是“一件中立的国”，此处作前置定语 a neutral state on the border。
neutral 意为“中立”，此处用 so neutral that 结构，说它中立到体育场里没人敢靠近。
neutral 意为“中立”，秩序册上 九月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的中立边境上的中立国，等于最高级的说法。
neutral 意为“中立”，母亲认为这件东西“太中立了，谁也用不上”，too neutral to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
neutral 意为“中性”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩中性的色”，此处作前置定语 a neutral colour of the walls。
neutral 意为“中性”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩墙壁的中性色一样中性”，同级比较用 as neutral as。
neutral 意为“中性”，秩序册上那半行字要的是“中性的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something neutral。
neutral 意为“中性”，邻体育场来的那位陪练认为这套计划“相当中性”，quite 修饰原级 neutral。
neutral 意为“中性”，no less neutral than 表示“其中性不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之中性不亚于任何人的预料。
neutral 意为“中性”，母亲 1995 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的中性色”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1983 年，运动员在秩序册里记下了一件中立的国。（a neutral state on the border）
它中立到体育场里没有一个人敢靠近。（so neutral that …）
母亲觉得它太中立，谁也用不上。（too neutral to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩中性的色。（a neutral colour of the walls）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩墙壁的中性色一样中性。（as neutral as …）
到了 1990 年，秩序册上只剩半行字：要的是一件中性的东西。（something neutral）
answers: In 1983 the athlete wrote of a neutral state on the border in the programme.
It was so neutral that nobody in the stadium would go near it.
My mother thought it too neutral to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a neutral colour of the walls.
He said nobody would call it as neutral as the colour of the walls they had once had.
By 1990 the programme asked for nothing but something neutral.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 neutral 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1983 the athlete wrote of a neutral state on the border in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the neutral state on the border that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too neutral to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a neutral colour of the walls, and nobody argued with him.
The trainer from the next stadium called the plan quite neutral, and everybody laughed.
The neutral ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
